items.title: Clinic Awareness & Brand Building
items.shortDescription: Build trust before a patient ever walks through your doors.
items.detailedDescription:
Today’s patients don't choose a healthcare provider blindly. Before booking an appointment, they search online, read reviews, visit websites, and compare options. If your clinic lacks a strong digital presence, potential patients may never consider your services—even if you provide exceptional care.

We help healthcare practices establish a credible and recognizable digital presence that positions them as the preferred choice within their community.

rows: Patients research clinics online before making healthcare decisions.
Your clinic creates a strong first impression across every digital touchpoint.
Many clinics struggle to clearly communicate their expertise and services.
Patients immediately understand your specialties and value.
Lack of consistent branding reduces trust and credibility.
A professional digital presence builds confidence before the first visit.
Competitors with stronger online visibility attract more patient inquiries.
Your clinic stands out and remains top-of-mind when care is needed.

items.title: Google Business Profile (GBP) Optimization
items.shortDescription: Stop losing local patients to your competitors down the street.
items.detailedDescription:
When someone in your neighborhood searches for a "dentist near me," a "pediatrician in [City]," or an "urgent care clinic," they rarely look past the top 3 results on Google Maps. If your clinic isn’t there, you are invisible to hundreds of active patients every single month.

We specialize in optimizing and managing Google Business Profiles specifically for healthcare practices to ensure you rank where patients are looking.

rows: 80%+ of patients use Google to find local care.
You appear right at the top when they search.
Friction: Missing hours or wrong phone numbers lose patients.
Clean, accurate, verified data builds instant trust.
Review Gap: Low or rare reviews push you down the algorithm.
A systematic approach to getting authentic 5-star patient feedback.

items.featuresTitle: What We Handle For Your Clinic

items.bottomLine: A properly optimized Google Business Profile acts like a billboard right at the moment a patient needs your care. Let us handle the algorithm while you handle the patients.

items.title: WhatsApp Automation
items.shortDescription: Reduce patient no-shows and streamline your front-desk operations.
items.detailedDescription: Managing patient appointments via manual phone calls is time-consuming for your administrative staff. Our WhatsApp automation services integrate directly into your clinic's daily workflow, handling routine patient communication efficiently and automatically. By reaching patients on an app they already use daily, you improve response rates and operational efficiency.

features.name: Appointment Confirmations & Reminders
features.description: Automatically send an instant confirmation when a booking is made, followed by 24-hour and 2-hour reminders. This systematically reduces expensive patient no-shows.

features.name: 24/7 Automated Responses
features.description: Program customized chatbot workflows to instantly answer frequently asked questions regarding clinic timings, precise locations, and lists of medical services, even after business hours.

features.name: Post-Consultation Follow-ups
features.description: Schedule automated messages to send necessary aftercare instructions for patient feedback and Google reviews.

features.name: Easy Rescheduling
features.description: Allow patients to cancel or request a reschedule through simple automated prompts, ensuring your calendar stays updated without tying up the phone lines.

items.bottomLine: Shifting routine administrative communication to WhatsApp drastically reduces the workload on your front desk. This allows your staff to focus entirely on in-person patient care while simultaneously improving overall patient satisfaction through fast, reliable communication.

items.title: Patient Management
items.shortDescription: Stop losing track of patient messages and missing critical health risks.
items.detailedDescription:
When your clinic or research group is busy, managing patient questions, appointments, and medical charts gets messy fast. If your team is constantly juggling phone calls, reading text messages, and checking health risks manually, important details get lost. This stresses your staff, frustrates patients, and slows down clinical trials.

We build an intelligent Digital Front Office (DFO) specifically for Doctors, Nurses, and Clinical Trial Managers (CROs) to handle the complete patient journey safely and automatically.

rows: Messy Inboxes: Patient messages are scattered across different apps, causing long delays.
A single, smart inbox that reads texts and shows who needs help first.
Hidden Risks: Dangerous health updates or vital sign changes get missed in a busy inbox.
An AI-driven Risk Engine that automatically flags urgent patient dangers, giving your team the scale to handle more patients safely.
Compliance Stress: Tracking doctor notes and trial records manually causes legal mistakes.
Strict, automatic audit logs that save every single action to keep your trials 100% compliant.

items.featuresTitle: What We Handle For Your Clinic
items.featuresSubtitle: We don’t just store medical charts; we turn your daily operations into a smooth, automated workflow machine.

features.name: Role-Based Smart Dashboards
features.description: We set up custom screens for Doctors, Nurses, and Trial Managers. It shows a live tracker of patient wait times (e.g., "Patient Anya waiting 22 mins") and highlights urgent health updates instantly.

features.name: Patient & Trial Lead CRM
features.description: Get a complete view of every patient’s medical history, past text chats, and health status in one click. It also includes a specialized pipeline to help trial managers track and enroll new clinical trial participants.

features.name: AI-Powered Risk Monitor
features.description: A safety tool that automatically categorizes patient dangers based on medical severity (RED for emergencies, YELLOW for warnings, BLUE for information) so you catch emergencies early.

features.name: Clinical Operations & Audit Logs
features.description: Easily book visits, log doctor consultation notes, and use secure audit logs that track every system change to keep your clinic 100% legally compliant.

features.name: Built-in AI Assistant
features.description: A smart helper bot integrated into the system. Your staff can ask it to instantly summarize a patient's history or check for scheduling mistakes, saving hours of typing.

items.bottomLine: Shifting your daily operations to our Digital Front Office eliminates administrative chaos. This allows your staff to focus entirely on in-person patient care while ensuring no medical emergency or trial record is ever missed.

items.name: Dr. B. Sireesha Rani
items.subtitle: MBBS, DNB, DRM (Germany)
items.bio: Infertility Specialist | Obstetrician & Gynecologist. 16+ years specializing in reproductive medicine and advanced gynecological care.
items.detailedBio:
Dr. B. Sireesha Rani is the Founder and Managing Director of Medcy Hospitals, as well as the Founder of Vizag IVF Centre and Lancet Laparoscopy Centre. With over 16+ years of experience in fertility management, she is widely recognized for her expertise in reproductive medicine and advanced gynecological care.

She completed her MBBS from Andhra Medical College, Visakhapatnam, and pursued her DNB in Obstetrics & Gynecology from the National Board of Examinations, New Delhi. Further strengthening her specialization, she obtained a Diploma in Reproductive Medicine and Embryology from Kiel University, Germany.

Dr. Sireesha Rani is actively involved in both government and private medical bodies across Andhra Pradesh and continues to contribute significantly to advancing fertility care standards.
items.leadershipVision:
Built upon the strong clinical excellence and ethical foundation established by Dr. Sireesha Rani through Medcy IVF, Medcy Hospitals extends this commitment into a comprehensive multi-specialty healthcare ecosystem.

Located in Arilova, Visakhapatnam, the hospital spans over 1,00,000+ sq. ft. of advanced medical infrastructure and is designed as a 108-bed tertiary care facility, focused on patient-centered care, innovation, and clinical precision.
positionsAwards: Founder & Managing Director — Vizag IVF Centre & Lancet Laparoscopy Centre
Joint Organizing Secretary — Andhra Medical College Century Celebrations
Secretary — AP Nursing Homes & Hospitals Association (APNA), Visakhapatnam
Secretary — OGSV (Obstetrics & Gynecological Society of Visakhapatnam) (2022–2023)
Joint Organizing Secretary — YUVA, FOGSI South Zone
Recipient of the prestigious “Most Preferred IVF Doctor in Andhra Pradesh” award
Award presented by Dr. M. Venkaiah Naidu (Former Vice President of India) on September 3rd, 2023
research: Published research on CASA-derived human sperm abnormalities, focusing on chromatin packing and DNA fragmentation
Actively contributes to academic conferences and medical advancements in reproductive health
items.whyConsult: At Medcy Hospitals, Dr. Sireesha Rani leads with a patient-first philosophy, combining clinical expertise with compassionate care. Her approach integrates advanced reproductive technologies, evidence-based treatments, and personalized care plans, ensuring the best outcomes for every patient.
items.address: Medcy Hospitals, Arilova, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh

items.name: Bhanu Prasad
items.subtitle: Enterprise Architect & Technology Leader
items.bio: Enterprise Architect & Technology Leader with over 20 years of experience in building scalable digital platforms and enterprise ecosystems.
items.detailedBio:
Bhanu Prasad is a seasoned enterprise architect and technology leader with over 20 years of experience in building scalable digital platforms, enterprise integrations, and end-to-end business solutions. With deep expertise in B2B commerce, CRM, and cloud-based ecosystems, he has consistently driven innovation and revenue growth across global organizations.

Currently serving as the Founder of Ottobon Inc, he focuses on building next-generation digital solutions that bridge business and technology seamlessly.
positionsAwards: Founder — Ottobon Inc (Oct 2024 – Present): Driving innovation in digital platforms and enterprise solutions with a focus on scalable, future-ready architectures.

Principal Architect — Keste (Jan 2018 – Aug 2024): Led presales and architecture for lead-to-cash solutions, enabling enterprise modernization and integration. Played a key role in increasing business revenue through innovative solution design.
Senior Solution Architect — Keste (Sep 2014 – Jan 2018): Delivered end-to-end B2B eCommerce solutions, managing multi-project teams and focusing on Oracle and Salesforce ecosystems.
Solution Architect — ROLTA | Americas (Jun 2013 – Sep 2014): Designed and implemented integration solutions using Oracle Fusion stack, primarily for the utilities sector.
Senior Consultant — Deloitte Consulting (Apr 2007 – Jun 2013): Architected CRM and SCM solutions while leading delivery teams to ensure high-quality enterprise implementations.
Software Engineer — Oracle Corporation (Apr 2006 – Apr 2007): Worked on Fusion Integration Services within JD Edwards, focusing on service enablement frameworks.
Software Engineer — Cordys R&D (Aug 2004 – Apr 2006): Contributed to product development in BPM and SOA-based process engines.
items.whyConsult: At Ottobon, Bhanu Prasad brings strategic vision and deep technical expertise to build scalable healthcare and enterprise platforms. His approach combines business-first thinking with robust technology architecture, ensuring impactful, efficient, and future-ready solutions.
